description:
Looking to add a little extra flair to your Chevrolet Corvette C8 2020-2023? Well, look no further than Vertical Doors Inc.'s line of lambo door conversion kits! These kits are specifically designed to make your vehicle's doors open vertically, just like a Lamborghini. VDI prides itself on manufacturing only the highest quality, strongest, and most affordable lambo door kits on the market. So you can rest assured that you're getting the best possible product for your money. Whether you're looking to make a statement on the street or show off your ride at the track, Vertical Doors Inc. has you covered. So don't wait any longer, order your lambo door kit today!

Fits the Chevrolet Corvette C8 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023. We also have Lambo Doors for all corvette models

WHAT'S INCLUDED:

  • 2 Gas Shocks
  • 2 Vertical Doors, Inc., Lambo Door Hinges (one for each side)
  • All Mounting Hardware
  • Tech Support For Install

WHY VERTICAL DOORS, INC KIT?

  • Direct "Bolt On" Hinge Kit
  • Mounts to Factory Bolt Pattern
  • Made in the USA from Domestic Hardened Steel
  • Patented in the USA
  • Completely Reversible
  • Opens Like Stock 45 Degrees & Lambo Style

TELL ME MORE:

These Lambo Door hinges are made from patented domestic hardened steel and are designed to fit factory bolt pattern. Plus, our doors are completely reversible, so you can change your mind at any time. The only choice when it comes to vertical lambo doors.
